_readme: Example Jev Triage settings for a fictional person. Import in Options → Import settings, then edit: rename labels, rewrite descriptions, swap the example senders for your own. Every domain below is made up (.example) — replace it or delete the rule.

actions.label: Jev/1-Reply
actions.desc: A real person wrote to me personally and is waiting for my answer: family, friends, my manager, a client, a landlord, a doctor's office.

actions.label: Jev/2-Action
actions.desc: No reply needed but I must do something: pay a bill, sign a document, RSVP, renew something, confirm an appointment, verify an account change I did not make.

actions.label: Jev/3-Read
actions.desc: Newsletters and articles I chose to subscribe to and like reading on the weekend.

actions.label: Jev/4-FYI
actions.desc: Receipts, shipping updates, booking confirmations, one-time codes, statements with nothing due, routine notifications.

actions.label: Jev/5-Low
actions.desc: Sales, coupons, 'we miss you' emails, product launches, webinars, surveys, social media notifications, cold sales pitches.

actions.label: Jev/6-Junk
actions.desc: Scams, phishing, fake invoices, prize or crypto offers, anything asking for passwords or payment out of the blue.

topics.label: Topic/Family
topics.desc: Partner, parents, siblings, relatives, family plans.

topics.label: Topic/Work
topics.desc: My job: colleagues, clients, projects, HR, payroll, expense reports.

topics.label: Topic/Side-Project
topics.desc: My small online shop: customer questions, orders from customers, payouts, supplier emails.

topics.label: Topic/Money
topics.desc: Bank, credit cards, bills, rent, taxes, insurance, investments.

topics.label: Topic/Home
topics.desc: Apartment, landlord, utilities, internet, repairs, deliveries to the house.

topics.label: Topic/Travel
topics.desc: Flights, hotels, car rentals, trip itineraries, visas, loyalty programs.

topics.label: Topic/Health
topics.desc: Doctors, dentist, pharmacy, insurance claims, gym, fitness apps.

topics.label: Topic/Learning
topics.desc: Online courses, certifications, books, podcasts and newsletters I learn from.

topics.label: Topic/Subscriptions
topics.desc: Streaming, apps and software I pay for: renewals, price changes, trial endings.

topics.label: Topic/Shopping
topics.desc: Stores and brands, my own orders, deliveries and returns.

topics.label: Topic/Security
topics.desc: Sign-in alerts, password resets, two-factor codes, new device notices.

topics.label: Topic/Other
topics.desc: Anything that fits none of the above.

rules._why: Must see: always surface my manager, Jev picks the action
Topic only: everything from my company is Work, Jev decides reply/action/FYI
Must see: a person who should never get buried
Topic only: statements are FYI, a missed payment becomes Action
Fixed action: new customer orders always need handling
Topic only: booking = FYI, gate change = Urgent
Topic only: renewal notices may need Action
Ignore: sales emails go out of the inbox, marked read
Fixed FYI: routine codes. Unexpected alerts from other senders still go to Jev

_ideas_to_enhance: Add a topic for something only you have: 'Topic/Volunteering', 'Topic/Wedding-2027', 'Topic/House-Hunt'.
Make descriptions concrete: list the kinds of senders and subjects you get, Jev reads them word for word.
Split an action if you need it: 'Jev/2-Pay' for bills and 'Jev/2-Sign' for documents.
Use a full address for people (mustSee) and a domain for companies (topic or action).
After a week, run Learn my inbox again: it only suggests senders that don't have a rule yet.
Turn off aggressive ignore in Options if you'd rather keep Low mail in the inbox, just labelled.
